categories.label: AI / Agentic / RAG Project Depth
categories.description: Real AI systems: agents, RAG, tools, retrieval, state, orchestration, evaluation, and meaningful business logic.

categories.label: Python & Backend Engineering
categories.description: Python, FastAPI, async programming, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Evidence in projects/internships over keyword-only lists.

categories.label: Cloud / Deployment / Full Stack
categories.description: GCP, Docker, and deployment. React/Next.js as supporting signals when part of an end-to-end system.

categories.label: GitHub Activity
categories.description: Recent public engineering activity (0-5) and maintained/relevant repositories (0-5). Missing GitHub must not fail screening.

categories.label: Engineering Depth Signals
categories.description: Testing, architecture, caching, queues, observability, concurrency, failure handling, and non-trivial practices.

requirements.description: Python must appear as a genuine skill, project technology, internship/work technology, or implementation language. JavaScript/Java/React-only profiles must be rejected.

The resume must show at least one meaningful AI/LLM/RAG/agentic project, framework, or implementation (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, LlamaIndex, RAG pipelines, vector search, tool-calling agents).

thin_llm_wrapper.reason: Deduct 5-15 points when an AI project is only a thin wrapper around an LLM/API call with no workflow, data processing, retrieval, state management, or backend logic.

project_quality_penalties.tutorial_or_weak_ownership: Deduct points for tutorial-style projects listed without implementation details or evidence of ownership.
project_quality_penalties.framework_name_only: Do not award full credit when a framework name appears only in the skills section without evidence of how it was used.
